candidate_sites.value: tier T4 refused; T2/T3 require non-empty approvals
candidate_sites.controls: Reference check: reserved constitutional process and minimum approval requirement per tier
candidate_sites.owner: Institutional-governance constitutional framework (tier table in process/PROPORTIONAL_GOVERNANCE.md)
candidate_sites.why: Floor-like tier->approval minimum; making it configurable would let a registry lower it. Reference harness only, non-authorizing (module docstring l.1-5).

candidate_sites.value: supports>3.0, refutes>3.0, contested band 1.0, ratios 2.0
candidate_sites.controls: Derived claim status supported/refuted/contested/proposed
candidate_sites.why: Epistemic labels, never gate an action; module not imported by app (grep) and README calls legacy surface non-authoritative.

candidate_sites.value: base 0.5; bonuses 0.1/0.1/0.1/0.2; robustness divisor 10.0
candidate_sites.controls: Evidence quality / robustness scores
candidate_sites.why: Informational scores in non-authoritative legacy FastAPI demo; nothing consumes them as authorization.

candidate_sites.value: quorum 0.5; quadratic scaling True
candidate_sites.controls: Pass/reject of in-memory governance proposals
candidate_sites.why: Voting outcome binds nothing in OCS; legacy unauthenticated demo. Not an OCS authority input.

candidate_sites.value: secret_key "dev-secret-key-change-in-production"; HS256; 30 min
candidate_sites.controls: Legacy JWT helper secret and lifetime
candidate_sites.why: Host secret; never registry data. Latent hygiene only: create_access_token/verify_token have no callers in app/ (grep), so no live exposure.

candidate_sites.value: strict comparisons, no tolerance for not_before/expires_at/key validity/revocation
candidate_sites.controls: Attestation verification time window
candidate_sites.why: Zero skew is fail-closed and revocation is intentionally conservative (comment l.52); a configurable tolerance could only widen acceptance.

candidate_sites.value: trust registry loaded per request from BITREP_TRUST_REGISTRY, fail-closed on missing/invalid
candidate_sites.controls: Which issuer keys are trusted
candidate_sites.why: Signing-root custody; load path already data-driven and fail-closed. Migrating trust roots to the Registry is prohibited by the rubric.

candidate_sites.value: days_until_expiry default 7
candidate_sites.controls: Legacy governance proposal lifetime
candidate_sites.why: Legacy BitRep governance demo; binds no OCS authority.

candidate_sites.value: depth 32, nodes 100000, string 1 MiB, dict 4096, list/tuple 10000
candidate_sites.controls: Ingress structural budget for pack JSON
candidate_sites.why: Mandatory ingress bound (G0-D-013 records only the 8 MiB cap); loosening is a resource risk, tightening has no authority meaning.

candidate_sites.value: privileged types: external_send,write,delete,export,purchase,approve
candidate_sites.controls: Advisory warnings when privileged action lacks review_required/authority_required
candidate_sites.why: Warning-only classification of action types; no gate and no authority creation. Not a policy input; leave in code.

candidate_sites.value: HMAC-SHA256, 64-hex digest form
candidate_sites.controls: Export integrity signature over bundles
candidate_sites.why: Evidence-integrity mechanism; algorithm and digest shape are not parameters.

candidate_sites.value: max_bytes 1048576, depth 20, nodes 16384, items 4096, fields 256, string 65536; 100 reported errors
candidate_sites.controls: Recipient/exporter ingress structural budget
candidate_sites.why: Mandatory ingress budget; G0-D-016 covers only the 5 s deadline. Not authority-bearing.

candidate_sites.value: max-age, tolerance, deadline, extension limit all read from the record/context
candidate_sites.controls: Contract conformance of recorded freshness bounds
candidate_sites.why: Validators hard-code no age/tolerance values; they check recorded values for sanity and consistency. Confirms ODES contains no policy literals beyond ingress budgets.
candidate_sites.evidence: see lines in file; grep for numeric thresholds found none

candidate_sites.value: observation_max_age_seconds>0, clock tolerance>=0 taken from the record
candidate_sites.controls: Independent re-check of recorded observation freshness
candidate_sites.why: Verifier carries no policy values of its own; it re-verifies what the record declares (its other limits are G0-D-028).

candidate_sites.value: max_uncommitted_events caller param, default 0
candidate_sites.controls: Custody-lag verdict compliant/violated for a context journal
candidate_sites.why: Per-call parameter with strictest default; only produces a non-authorizing assessment (LIMITS authorizing False). Analogous to G0-D-020 but a distinct site.

candidate_sites.value: contract fields max_uncertainty, max_resolution, minimum_count, max_gap_ppm<=1e6, max_age; hard-coded len(groups)>=2
candidate_sites.controls: Execution-contract admission for spatial/population evidence (non-authorizing reference)
candidate_sites.owner: Contract author per run (declared in execution-contract)
candidate_sites.why: Values declared per run, not code defaults; groups>=2 is a structural invariant (RETAIN child). Registry could at most narrow, no current need.

candidate_sites.value: max_amount 1000, max_effects 1, USD, prefix urn:cognous:synthetic-account:, approved $10 case-1
candidate_sites.controls: LocalExecutionPolicy and approval for the synthetic refund ingress
candidate_sites.why: Synthetic host for MVP qualification (non-locked tool); mirrors Runtime host policy, not a production site.

candidate_sites.value: MAX_REQUEST_BYTES 4096, READ_TIMEOUT 5.0 s, MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES 8192, client timeout 15 s; allowed_uids passed by host
candidate_sites.controls: Ingress DoS bounds; peer-uid allowlist
candidate_sites.why: Mechanism bounds are fixed; allowed_uids is deployment-supplied host data (PROVIDER-OR-HOST-OWNED child), never registry-governed authority.

candidate_sites.value: ENFORCEABLE_FS {ext4,xfs,btrfs,tmpfs}; NO_UNIX_PERMS_FS; PRIVILEGED_CAPS; SOCKET_MODE 0o660
candidate_sites.controls: Which host filesystems/capabilities pass the ingress environment check
candidate_sites.why: Security judgement of what counts as enforceable; making it configurable would let weaker hosts pass (widening).

candidate_sites.value: MAX_CHECKS 512 etc.; floor ids passed explicitly, empty floor refused, no default floor
candidate_sites.controls: Mandatory-check manifest validation and completeness
candidate_sites.why: Floor is a protected invariant by design (caller-supplied, non-empty); bounds are schema limits. Do not migrate.

candidate_sites.value: STATUSES required/advisory; DISPOSITIONS deny/hold/quarantine/require_authority/require_evidence; MISSING_TREATMENTS {fail_closed}
candidate_sites.controls: Parallel ocs-registry-record/0 profile (step 2.1)
candidate_sites.why: Second record format beside Registry r08-v2 (G0 notes finding 7, not a ledger row). Blocking question: is ocs-registry-record/0 superseded by the Registry repo format, and which is the migration target?

candidate_sites.value: 100% applicable-suite pass, no unexplained skips/xfails; declared known-limit set derived from the twin
candidate_sites.controls: Publication criteria and known-limit accounting for qualification
candidate_sites.why: Qualification governance must stay independent of the registry it qualifies; criteria are preregistered process, not runtime policy. G0-D-029 covers only timeout/size.

candidate_sites.value: OPA comparator allow-lists, parameter envelope, 10 gateway tools
candidate_sites.controls: Comparator application configuration for the benchmark
candidate_sites.why: Cognous-configured comparator used for scoring; not an OCS production policy site.
